instructions:
Ouroboros (palace_* tools) is the owner's memory. Ask it with palace_query — a sentence, not
keywords: near "<text>" (meaning) · diffuse S from "<note>" (structural neighbours) · reach F from
"<note>" (citations) · relate "<note>" · trace "<note>" (versions) · walk from "<note>" via F+ ·
read "<ref>" (full text: read before quoting) · witness "<edge id>". Combine with and, or, minus,
then; within <region>, over <strata>; top k, atleast t, far, not. trace: true shows the work (the plan's rewrites, each clause's arithmetic, the ranking) when an answer surprises. Papers: near "<text>" over curated
([unreviewed] = claim, not fact). A hypothetical, assume S "a" "b" +0.5 in <sentence>, answers as a
Hyp, never a fact. Cite refs. General knowledge: no query. Capture only when asked. Jobs, imports,
what is due: palace_status. Tasks and reminders: palace_task_* and palace_remind. Never put palace
content in web searches.

tools.name: query
tools.description: The one read: a sentence of the query algebra, not keywords. Verbs: near "text" | diffuse S from <note> [beta b] | reach F from <note> [depth n] [back|forward] | relate <note> | trace <note> | walk from <note> [to <note>] via <regex over S,F,D,C> | witness "<edge id>" | read "<ref>" [chunk n] (the full text; read before quoting). Connectives and, or, minus, then; adjectives within <region>, over <strata>; top k, atleast t, far, not; assume <rel> <a> <b> [+w] in <sentence> (a hypothetical: the answer is a Hyp, never a fact). A <note> is a quoted path or title. Papers: over curated. Example: top 5 (near "sleep" and diffuse S from "health.md"), the five best of the product; top k takes its field with the field's adjectives, so top 5 near "x" within <region> ranks within it. The plan rides with the answer; a refusal names the word that would fix it; trace: true shows the work: the parse, every rewrite with its law, the support's census, each clause's arithmetic, the ranking.

trace.description: show the work: the parse, the rewrites and their laws, the census, each clause's arithmetic, the ranking
